research_notes: A useful future validation matrix could include representative normal workload plus W3 mixed I/O stress and a reasoning-heavy profile near the candidate cap.
Five clean validations need not all be identical if the goal is a universal cap, but profile coverage should be explicit.
If the cap is profile-specific, each profile needs its own sufficient evidence instead.
The simpler universal cap should be preferred unless capacity loss is material.
Current sample is one W3 exploratory observation.
